summary: Canton Island Airport serves Abariringa (Canton Island), a remote coral atoll in the Phoenix Islands group of Kiribati in the central Pacific Ocean. The airstrip has notable historical significance as a former refueling stop for Pan American Airways' trans-Pacific Clipper services in the 1930s and 1940s. Today, the surrounding waters form part of the Phoenix Islands Protected Area, one of the largest marine protected areas in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
